steps: The maximum energy of the X-ray is E = 24800 eV, corresponding to a wavelength λ = hc/E.
The de-Broglie wavelength of the electron is λ_e = h/p.
Equating the wavelengths (λ = λ_e) gives h/p = hc/E, which implies the electron's momentum is p = E/c.
The kinetic energy of the electron is K = p² / (2m) = E² / (2mc²).
Using the rest mass energy of an electron mc² ≈ 511 keV, we get K = (24800)² / (2 × 511000) eV.
Calculating this gives K ≈ 615040000 / 1022000 ≈ 601 eV, which is approximately 600 eV.
